intent: Reuse CAP-0001/CAP-0002 to preserve and ground CoreWeave's August 28, 2024 primary-source H200 market-availability statement. The source may support a later Reality that H200 cloud infrastructure was brought to market/deployed by that vintage. It must not be promoted as proof that NVIDIA H200 platform shipments began in calendar Q2 2024, and any comparison to Micron's February H200 shipment Judgment must remain related_milestone unless a direct shipment-start source is recovered.
rationale: Primary-source exhaustion has not produced a retrospective source proving the Q2 shipment-start timing. CoreWeave's own August 28 release is nevertheless claim-scoped primary evidence for H200 market availability and deployed H200 instances. Preserving that later milestone improves the archive while maintaining the unresolved timing gap.
